            let step = semio_framework_value::retained_clone::admit_retained_clone_close(inner,step,retirement.terminal_is_empty(),"replacement original candidate root").map_err(semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::PluginLifecycleFailure::from)?;
            let receipt = step.progress();
            return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress { copied_bytes: receipt.copied_bytes + reserved, ..receipt }));
        }
        if self.candidate_content.is_some() { let content = self.candidate_content.take().expect("original candidate root remains retained"); *self.candidate_content_retirement = Some(ChildContentRetirement::new(content,true)); return Ok(paid()); }
        if let Some(composition) = self.candidate_composition.as_mut() {
            if composition.terminal_is_empty() { drop(self.candidate_composition.take()); return Ok(paid()); }
            let step = composition.close_step(child).map_err(semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::PluginLifecycleFailure::from)?; return parent(step,composition.terminal_is_empty());
        }
        if let Some(pins) = self.displaced_pins.as_mut() {
            if pins.terminal_is_empty() { drop(self.displaced_pins.take()); return Ok(paid()); }
            let step = pins.close_step(child)?; return parent(step,pins.terminal_is_empty());
        }
        if let Some(retirement) = self.retiring_child.as_mut() {
            if retirement.terminal_is_empty() { drop(self.retiring_child.take()); return Ok(paid()); }
            let step = retirement.close_step(child)?; return parent(step,retirement.terminal_is_empty());
        }
        if let Some(children) = self.candidate_children.as_mut() {
            if children.has_admission_in_flight() { return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput { reason: "replacement original member reservation awaits its admitted owner" }); }
            if children.len() != 0 {
                let index = children.dense_slots[children.len()-1];
                let entry = children.take_at(index).expect("original dense replacement member remains occupied");
                *self.retiring_child = Some(ChildMemberRetirement::new(entry));
                self.retiring_child_cursor = index;
                return Ok(paid());
            }
            if !children.slots.is_empty() { drop(std::mem::take(&mut children.slots)); children.allocation_admitted = false; return Ok(paid()); }
            drop(self.candidate_children.take()); return Ok(paid());
        }
        if self.cancel.is_some() { let original = self.cancel.take().expect("original replacement cancellation remains retained"); *self.cancel_retirement = Some(semio_framework_async::CancelTokenRetirement::from_token(original)); return Ok(paid()); }
        if let Some(cancel) = self.cancel_retirement.as_mut() {
            if cancel.terminal_is_empty() { drop(self.cancel_retirement.take()); return Ok(paid()); }
            return match cancel.close_step(child) {
                Ok(step) => parent(step,cancel.terminal_is_empty()),
                Err(semio_framework_async::CancelTokenRetirementError::Blocked(_)) => Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput { reason: "replacement original cancellation retains its waiter or alias" }),
                Err(semio_framework_async::CancelTokenRetirementError::Refused(error)) => Err(semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::PluginLifecycleFailure::from(error)),
            };
        }
        if let Some(original) = self.cancel_signal.as_ref() {
            if std::sync::Arc::strong_count(original) != 1 || std::sync::Arc::weak_count(original) != 0 { return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput { reason: "replacement original cancellation signal retains an external owner" }); }
            return match std::sync::Arc::try_unwrap(self.cancel_signal.take().unwrap()) {
                Ok(original) => { drop(original); Ok(paid()) },
                Err(original) => { *self.cancel_signal = Some(original); Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput { reason: "replacement original cancellation signal acquired an alias" }) },
            };
        }
        self.state = if self.retained_store.is_some() { if self.committed { ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::RetiringCommittedStore } else { ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::RetiringRejectedCandidate } } else { ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::Complete };
        Ok(paid())
    }

    pub fn drive_initializer(&mut self,cx:&mut semio_framework_job::StepContext<'_>, grant: RetainedCloneGrant) -> Result<PluginLifecycleStep, semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::PluginLifecycleFailure> {
        if self.state!=ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::Initializing{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput{reason:"store initializer awaits its actual replacement stage"});}
        if grant.maximum_items==0||grant.maximum_depth==0{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(Default::default()));}
        let business_cancelled=self.cancelled();
        if let Some(rejected)=self.session_rejected.as_mut(){
            if rejected.admission_pending()&&!cx.is_cancelled()&&!business_cancelled{
                let config=semio_framework_job_worker_authority::BatchDriveConfig{retained:grant,site:"artifact_store_replacement",stage:semio_framework_job::InteractiveStage::InteractiveStep,fuel_per_step:cx.fuel_remaining(),step_budget_us:0};
                let before=cx.retained_progress();
                if let Some(session)=rejected.admit_pending(config,cx)?{*self.session=Some(session);drop(self.session_rejected.take());}
                return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::original_lifecycle_delta(before,cx.retained_progress())?));
            }

            if rejected.terminal_is_empty(){
                let bytes=size_of_val(rejected);if grant.maximum_copy_bytes<bytes{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(Default::default()));}
                drop(self.session_rejected.take());self.refuse(if cx.is_cancelled()||business_cancelled{ArtifactStoreReplacementRefusal::Cancelled}else{ArtifactStoreReplacementRefusal::InitializerAdmissionRejected});
                return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,copied_bytes:bytes,..Default::default()}));
            }
            let demand=rejected.retirement_demands(grant.maximum_copy_bytes)?;
            return original_rejection_lifecycle(cx,demand,grant,"store initializer rejection awaits its original worker",|cx|{let step=rejected.close_step(cx)?;Ok((step,rejected.terminal_is_empty()))});
        }
        if self.outcome_pending{
            let session=self.session.as_mut().ok_or_else(||plugin_sdk_fault("store initializer original outcome acknowledgement lost its session"))?;
            let step=session.acknowledge_checked_out_outcome(grant);
            if matches!(step,RetainedCloneStep::Complete(_)){
                self.outcome_pending=false;
                if let Some(progress) = session.checked_out_job_mut().map(|job| job.progress()).filter(|(_, total)| *total > 0) {
                    self.fold_progress = progress;
                }
                match self.outcome_terminal.take() {
                    Some((1, _)) => {
                        let candidate = session
                            .checked_out_job_mut()
                            .and_then(ArtifactStoreInitializationJob::take_candidate)
                            .ok_or_else(|| Fault::new(FaultOrigin::Framework, FaultCode::new("artifact-store.initializer-candidate-missing"), "completed store initializer lost its exact candidate"))?;
                        *self.retained_store = Some(candidate);
                        self.terminal_target = Some(ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::AwaitingMembers);
                    }
                    Some((2, initializer_code)) => {
                        let accepted = session.checked_out_job_mut().is_some_and(ArtifactStoreInitializationJob::accept_terminal_failure);
                        if !accepted {
                            return Err(Fault::new(FaultOrigin::Framework, FaultCode::new("artifact-store.initializer-failure-retirement"), "failed store initializer did not reach terminal-empty authority").into());
                        }
                        self.refusal.get_or_insert(ArtifactStoreReplacementRefusal::InitializerFailed(initializer_code));
                        self.terminal_target = Some(ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::RetiringRejectedMembers);
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
                self.resume_pending=true;
            }
            return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::retained(step,false));
        }
        if self.resume_pending{
            if grant.maximum_copy_bytes<size_of::<bool>(){return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(Default::default()));}
            let session=self.session.as_mut().ok_or_else(||plugin_sdk_fault("store initializer original outcome handback lost its session"))?;
            if self.terminal_target.is_some(){session.begin_close();}else if session.resume().is_err(){return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput{reason:"store initializer original outcome resume remains contended"});}
            self.resume_pending=false;
            return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,copied_bytes:size_of::<bool>(),..Default::default()}));
        }
        if let Some(target)=self.terminal_target{
            let session=self.session.as_mut().ok_or_else(||plugin_sdk_fault("store initializer terminal target lost its original session"))?;
            if session.terminal_is_empty(){
                let bytes=size_of_val(session);if grant.maximum_copy_bytes<bytes{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(Default::default()));}
                drop(self.session.take());self.terminal_target=None;self.state=target;
                return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,copied_bytes:bytes,..Default::default()}));
            }
            let demand=match session.retirement_demands(grant.maximum_copy_bytes){Ok(demand)=>demand,Err(semio_framework_job_worker::WorkerJobDemandError::Contention(_))=>return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput{reason:"store initializer original quote awaits worker handback"}),Err(semio_framework_job_worker::WorkerJobDemandError::Refused(error))=>return Err(error.into())};
            return original_worker_lifecycle(cx,demand,grant,"store initializer original terminal worker remains contended",|cx|{let step=session.close_step(cx)?;Ok((step,session.terminal_is_empty()))});
        }
        let session = self.session.as_mut().ok_or_else(|| Fault::new(FaultOrigin::Framework, FaultCode::new("artifact-store.initializer-session-missing"), "store initializer lost its retained session before terminal recovery"))?;
        match session.pump_one_for_interactive_turn(cx) {
            Ok(semio_framework_job_worker::WorkerJobPoll::Outcome | semio_framework_job_worker::WorkerJobPoll::Terminal) => {
                let Some((issued, progress)) = session.take_checked_out_retained_step_receipt() else { return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Blocked { reason: "store initializer original receipt awaits its sole recipient" }) };
                if !progress.fits(issued) || !progress.fits(grant) {
                    return Err(Fault::new(FaultOrigin::Framework, FaultCode::new("artifact-store.initializer-receipt"), "store initializer original receipt exceeded its received turn").with_retained_progress(progress).into());
                }
                self.outcome_terminal = match session.checked_out_outcome() {
                    Ok(Some(semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeView::Complete { .. })) => Some((1, ArtifactStoreRefusalCode::EMPTY)),
                    Ok(Some(semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeView::Cancelled { .. })) => Some((2, ArtifactStoreRefusalCode::from_page(b"initializer-cancelled"))),
                    Ok(Some(semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeView::Fault { detail, .. })) => Some((2, ArtifactStoreRefusalCode::from_page(detail.page(0).unwrap_or(b"initializer-faulted-without-detail")))),
                    Ok(Some(_)) | Ok(None) => None,
                    Err(_) => return Err(Fault::new(FaultOrigin::Framework, FaultCode::new("artifact-store.initializer-outcome-missing"), "store initializer checkout lost its exact outcome").into()),
                };
                self.outcome_pending = true;
                Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(progress))
            }
            Ok(semio_framework_job_worker::WorkerJobPoll::Submitted | semio_framework_job_worker::WorkerJobPoll::Idle) => Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,..Default::default()})),
            Ok(_) => Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput { reason: "store initializer awaits its mounted wake" }),
            Err(failure) => Err(failure.into()),
        }
    }

    /// 📏️ Quotes the exact next retirement turn of the current retiring state: one member owner, or the retained Store and its disposer.
    pub fn retirement_demands(&self, body: usize) -> Result<RetirementDemand, ValueError> {
        let item = RetirementDemand { depth: 1, ..Default::default() };
        if matches!(self.state, ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::RetiringRejectedMembers | ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::RetiringCommittedMembers) {
            return self.replacement_member_retirement_demands(body);
        }
        let Some(store) = self.retained_store.as_ref() else { return Ok(item) };
        let Some(disposer) = self.retained_disposer.as_ref() else {
            return Ok(RetirementDemand { copy_bytes: size_of_val(store) + size_of::<ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState>(), release_bytes: size_of_val(&**store), ..item });
        };
        if disposer.terminal_is_empty(store) { return Ok(RetirementDemand { copy_bytes: size_of_val(disposer), release_bytes: size_of_val(&**disposer), ..item }); }
        disposer.retirement_demands(store, body)
    }

    pub fn drive_retained_store(&mut self, grant: RetainedCloneGrant) -> Result<PluginLifecycleStep, Fault> {
        if grant.maximum_items==0||grant.maximum_depth==0{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(Default::default()));}
        let Some(store)=self.retained_store.as_mut()else{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::AwaitingInput{reason:"replacement original cancellation and closure owners retain their physical authority"});};
        let Some(disposer)=self.retained_disposer.as_mut()else{
            if !store.close_owned_store_terminal_is_empty(){return Err(plugin_sdk_fault("retained replacement Store lost its exact granted disposer"));}
            let demand=RetirementDemand{copy_bytes:size_of_val(store)+size_of::<ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState>(),release_bytes:size_of_val(&**store),depth:1,..Default::default()};
            if grant.maximum_copy_bytes<demand.copy_bytes||grant.maximum_release_bytes<demand.release_bytes{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(Default::default()));}
            return semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::runtime_lifecycle_step(demand,grant,|_|{
                drop(self.retained_store.take());self.state=if self.member_owners_terminal_is_empty(){ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::Complete}else{ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::RetiringRejectedMembers};
                Ok((PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,copied_bytes:demand.copy_bytes,released_bytes:demand.release_bytes,..Default::default()}),false))
            });
        };
        if disposer.terminal_is_empty(store){
            let demand=RetirementDemand{copy_bytes:size_of_val(disposer),release_bytes:size_of_val(&**disposer),depth:1,..Default::default()};
            if grant.maximum_copy_bytes<demand.copy_bytes||grant.maximum_release_bytes<demand.release_bytes{return Ok(PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(Default::default()));}
            return semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::runtime_lifecycle_step(demand,grant,|_|{
                drop(self.retained_disposer.take());
                Ok((PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,copied_bytes:demand.copy_bytes,released_bytes:demand.release_bytes,..Default::default()}),false))
            });
        }
        let demand=disposer.retirement_demands(store,grant.maximum_copy_bytes).map_err(|error|plugin_sdk_fault(error.to_string()))?;
        semio_framework_plugin_ownership::bounded_ownership::runtime_lifecycle_step(demand,grant,|grant|{
            let step=disposer.close_step(store,grant)?;
            if matches!(step,PluginLifecycleStep::Complete(_))&&!disposer.terminal_is_empty(store){return Err(plugin_sdk_fault("replacement original disposer completed with retained Store owners"));}
            Ok((match step{PluginLifecycleStep::Complete(progress)=>PluginLifecycleStep::Progress(progress),step=>step},false))
        })
    }

    fn member_owners_terminal_is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.closure.is_none()
            && self.cancel.is_none()
            && self.cancel_signal.is_none()
            && self.cancel_retirement.is_none()
            && self.member_ingress.is_none()
            && self.active_member_ingress.is_none()
            && self.active_member_open.is_none()
            && self.member_open_admission.is_none()
            && self.opened_member.is_none()
            && self.candidate_children.is_none()
            && self.candidate_content.is_none()
            && self.candidate_content_retirement.is_none()
            && self.displaced_content_retirements.is_none()
            && self.candidate_composition.is_none()
            && self.displaced_pins.is_none()
            && self.retiring_child.is_none()
    }

    pub fn terminal_is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.state == ActiveArtifactStoreReplacementState::Complete && self.member_owners_terminal_is_empty() && self.session.is_none() && self.session_rejected.is_none() && !self.outcome_pending && self.retained_store.is_none() && self.retained_disposer.is_none()
    }
}

impl<P, Mutation, M> Drop for ActiveArtifactStoreReplacement<P, Mutation, M>
where
    P: Clone + semio_framework_value::ToValue + semio_framework_value::FromValue + ArtifactPack + ::semio_framework_os_kernel::os_store::serialization::ArtifactStoreSnapshot + semio_framework_schema_composition::ArtifactCompositionFields + Send + Sync + 'static,
    Mutation: Clone + semio_framework_value::ToValue + semio_framework_value::FromValue + store::Mutation<P> + OpBinary + OpText + Send + 'static,
    M: SpaceMember + MemberFactory,
{
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        assert!(
            std::thread::panicking() || self.terminal_is_empty(),
            "artifact store replacement reached Drop before initializer/candidate/displaced-store ownership was terminal empty"
        );
    }
}

#[doc(hidden)]
pub struct ArtifactStoreReplacementAdmissionTarget<'a, A: ArtifactApp, M: SpaceMember + MemberFactory> {
    pub jobs: &'a mut ArtifactFixedRegistry<ActiveArtifactStoreReplacement<A::Snapshot, A::Mutation, M>>,
    pub operation: semio_framework_job::OperationId,
    pub generation: semio_framework_job::Generation,
    pub child_content_generation: u64,
    pub source_identity:(semio_framework_job::OperationId,semio_framework_job::Generation),
    pub actor: ActorId,
    pub marker: std::marker::PhantomData<fn() -> A>,
}

impl<A: ArtifactApp, M: SpaceMember + MemberFactory> store::os_store::owned_schema_decode::ArtifactEnvelopeCompletedRecordTarget<A::Snapshot, A::Mutation> for ArtifactStoreReplacementAdmissionTarget<'_, A, M> {
    fn try_adopt_completed(&mut self, mut envelope: ArtifactEnvelope<A::Snapshot, A::Mutation>) -> Result<(), ArtifactEnvelope<A::Snapshot, A::Mutation>> {
        if envelope.dialect.is_none() {
            envelope.dialect = Some(A::DIALECT.into());
        }
        if envelope.schema != A::DOCUMENT_SCHEMA || envelope.dialect != Some(A::DIALECT.into()) || !self.jobs.can_insert(self.operation.0) {
            return Err(envelope);
        }
        let job = A::build_document_store_initialization_job(envelope, self.operation, self.generation, self.actor.clone())?;
        self.jobs.insert_admitted(self.operation.0, ActiveArtifactStoreReplacement::new(self.operation,self.generation,self.child_content_generation,job,self.source_identity));
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// 🗂️ Generation-keyed immutable document, configuration, and history projections.
#[doc(hidden)]
pub type AppProjectionCache<A> = ((u64, u64, u64, HistoryCommandFilter), std::sync::Arc<<A as ArtifactApp>::Snapshot>, std::sync::Arc<<A as ArtifactApp>::Config>, std::sync::Arc<HistoryView>);

#[doc(hidden)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState {
    Pending,
    Running,
    Ready,
    Cancelled,
    Fault,
}

#[doc(hidden)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadPhase {
    DecodeParent,
    RetireParentHistoryAuxiliary,
    MergeParent,
    HydrateParent,
    AwaitingMembers,
    BeginMember,
    FillMember,
    RetireMemberSource,
    AdmitMember,
    SealMembers,
    AwaitReplacement,
    Terminal,
}

#[doc(hidden)]
pub struct PendingDocumentArchiveMember {
    pub entry: Option<protocol::OwnedDocumentMemberPackEntry>,
    entry_retirement: Option<Box<dyn store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement>>,
    pub pages: Option<store::os_store::owned_schema_decode::OwnedSchemaDecodePages>,
    pub copied: usize,
    pub identity_field: u8,
}

impl PendingDocumentArchiveMember {
    fn empty_ingress() -> OwnedDocumentMemberIngress {
        OwnedDocumentMemberIngress { identity: ManuallyDrop::new(None), request: ManuallyDrop::new(None), identity_field: 0 }
    }

    pub fn new(entry: protocol::OwnedDocumentMemberPackEntry) -> Result<Self, (Fault, protocol::OwnedDocumentMemberPackEntry)> {
        let page_count = entry.envelope_pack.len().div_ceil(store::os_store::owned_schema_decode::OWNED_SCHEMA_DECODE_PAGE_BYTES);
        let pages = match store::os_store::owned_schema_decode::OwnedSchemaDecodePages::try_with_credits(store::os_store::owned_schema_decode::OwnedSchemaDecodeCredits { maximum_pages: page_count, maximum_bytes: entry.envelope_pack.len() }) {
            Ok(pages) => pages,
            Err(fault) => return Err((document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, format!("document archive member page authority was rejected: {fault:?}")), entry)),
        };
        Ok(Self { entry: Some(entry), entry_retirement: None, pages: Some(pages), copied: 0, identity_field: 0 })
    }

    pub fn fill_one_page(&mut self, maximum_bytes: usize) -> Result<bool, Fault> {
        let entry = self.entry.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, "document archive member source owner is absent"))?;
        if self.copied == entry.envelope_pack.len() {
            return Ok(true);
        }
        let end = self.copied.saturating_add(store::os_store::owned_schema_decode::OWNED_SCHEMA_DECODE_PAGE_BYTES).min(entry.envelope_pack.len());
        let length = end - self.copied;
        if length > maximum_bytes {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        let page = store::os_store::owned_schema_decode::OwnedSchemaDecodePage::try_from_slice(&entry.envelope_pack[self.copied..end]).map_err(|_| document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, "document archive member page exceeded its fixed extent"))?;
        self.pages.as_mut().ok_or_else(|| document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, "document archive member page owner is absent"))?.admit_page(page).map_err(|_| document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, "document archive member page was rejected by its exact authority"))?;
        self.copied = end;
        Ok(self.copied == entry.envelope_pack.len())
    }

    /// 📏️ The source bytes still owned: payload truncation, then their whole physical backing.
    pub fn source_retirement_demands(&self) -> RetirementDemand {
        self.entry.as_ref().map_or_else(RetirementDemand::default, |entry| plugin_bytes_retirement_demand(&entry.envelope_pack))
    }

    pub fn retire_source_step(&mut self, grant: RetainedCloneGrant) -> RetainedCloneStep {
        let empty = RetainedCloneProgress::default();
        let Some(entry) = self.entry.as_mut() else { return RetainedCloneStep::Complete(empty) };
        match plugin_bytes_close(&mut entry.envelope_pack, grant) {
            Some(progress) => RetainedCloneStep::Progress(progress),
            None => RetainedCloneStep::Complete(empty),
        }
    }
    pub fn take_ingress(&mut self, handle: ArtifactEnvelopeDecodeOperationHandle, actor: ActorId) -> Result<OwnedDocumentMemberIngress, (Fault, OwnedDocumentMemberIngress)> {
        let mut entry = self.entry.take().ok_or_else(|| (document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, "document archive member identity owner is absent"), Self::empty_ingress()))?;
        if !entry.envelope_pack.is_empty() {
            self.entry = Some(entry);
            return Err((document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, "document archive member source bytes remain live before identity transfer"), Self::empty_ingress()));
        }
        let mut pages = self.pages.take().ok_or_else(|| (document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, "document archive member page owner is absent"), Self::empty_ingress()))?;
        if let Err(fault) = pages.seal() {
            self.entry = Some(entry);
            self.pages = Some(pages);
            return Err((document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, format!("document archive member pages could not seal: {fault:?}")), Self::empty_ingress()));
        }
        let reference = ArtifactRef {
            artifact_id: std::mem::take(&mut entry.reference.artifact_id),
            dialect: ArtifactDialect { artifact_kind: std::mem::take(&mut entry.reference.artifact_kind), standard: std::mem::take(&mut entry.reference.standard), subset: std::mem::take(&mut entry.reference.subset) },
        };
        let owner = store::OwnerRef {
            parent: ArtifactRef {
                artifact_id: std::mem::take(&mut entry.owner.parent.artifact_id),
                dialect: ArtifactDialect { artifact_kind: std::mem::take(&mut entry.owner.parent.artifact_kind), standard: std::mem::take(&mut entry.owner.parent.standard), subset: std::mem::take(&mut entry.owner.parent.subset) },
            },
            slot: std::mem::take(&mut entry.owner.slot),
            child_id: std::mem::take(&mut entry.owner.child_id),
        };
        let ordinal = entry.ordinal as usize;
        drop(entry);
        let request = match store::MemberOpenRequest::new(handle.operation, handle.generation, u64::MAX, reference.clone(), Some(owner.clone()), pages, actor).admit(1) {
            Ok(request) => request,
            Err(rejected) => {
                let ingress = OwnedDocumentMemberIngress { identity: ManuallyDrop::new(Some((ordinal, reference, owner))), request: ManuallyDrop::new(Some(rejected.request)), identity_field: 0 };
                return Err((document_load_fault(DOCUMENT_LOAD_FAILED_CODE, format!("document archive member request was rejected: {:?}", rejected.diagnostic)), ingress));
            }
        };
        OwnedDocumentMemberIngress::try_new(ordinal, reference, owner, request)
    }

    /// 📏️ Borrows original member and whole page-directory demands before any transfer.
    pub fn retirement_demands(&self, body: usize) -> Result<RetirementDemand, ValueError> {
        if let Some(pages)=self.pages.as_ref() {
            return Ok(if let Some(bytes)=pages.close_page_bytes() { RetirementDemand{copy_bytes:bytes,depth:1,..Default::default()} }
                else { RetirementDemand{release_bytes:pages.allocation_byte_demand(),depth:1,..Default::default()} });
        }
        if let Some(owner)=self.entry_retirement.as_ref() {
            let mut demand=store::os_store::snapshot_read::artifact_retirement_box_demands(owner,body)?;
            demand.depth=demand.depth.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(||ValueError::literal(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::DepthLimit,"archive member retirement parent depth overflow"))?;
            return Ok(demand);
        }
        Ok(if self.entry.is_some() { RetirementDemand{capacity_bytes:semio_framework_value::retirement::owned_retirement_birth_bytes::<protocol::OwnedDocumentMemberPackEntry>(),depth:2,..Default::default()} } else { Default::default() })
    }

    /// 🧹️ Pays inline payload work and releases each original physical allocation separately.
    pub fn close_step(&mut self, grant: RetainedCloneGrant) -> Result<RetainedCloneStep, ValueError> {
        let empty=RetainedCloneProgress::default();
        if self.terminal_is_empty(){return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Complete(empty));}
        let demand=self.retirement_demands(grant.maximum_copy_bytes)?;
        if grant.maximum_items==0||grant.maximum_copy_bytes<demand.copy_bytes||grant.maximum_capacity_bytes<demand.capacity_bytes||grant.maximum_release_bytes<demand.release_bytes||grant.maximum_depth<demand.depth{return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(empty));}
        if let Some(pages)=self.pages.as_mut() {
            if let Some(page)=pages.close_take_page(){let bytes=page.len();drop(page);return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,copied_bytes:bytes,..empty}));}
            if !pages.terminal_is_empty(){return pages.close_backing_step(grant).map(|step|RetainedCloneStep::Progress(step.progress()));}
            drop(self.pages.take());return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,..empty}));
        }
        let child=RetainedCloneGrant{maximum_depth:grant.maximum_depth-1,..grant};
        if self.entry_retirement.is_some(){return store::os_store::snapshot_read::artifact_retirement_box_close_step(&mut self.entry_retirement,child).map(|step|RetainedCloneStep::Progress(step.progress()));}
        let original=self.entry.take().expect("quoted original archive member");
        match semio_framework_value::retirement::admit_owned_retirement(original,child) {
            Ok((owner,progress))=>{self.entry_retirement=Some(owner);semio_framework_value::retained_clone::admit_retained_clone_progress(child,progress,"original archive member birth")?;Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(progress))}
            Err((error,original))=>{self.entry=Some(original);Err(error)}
        }
    }
    pub fn terminal_is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.entry.is_none() && self.entry_retirement.is_none() && self.pages.is_none()
    }
}

impl Drop for PendingDocumentArchiveMember {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        assert!(std::thread::panicking() || self.terminal_is_empty(), "recursive document archive member reached Drop before its source and page owners were terminal empty");
    }
}

fn document_archive_member_identity(entry: &protocol::OwnedDocumentMemberPackEntry, field: u8) -> Option<&String> {
    match field {
        0 => Some(&entry.reference.artifact_id),
        1 => Some(&entry.reference.artifact_kind),
        2 => Some(&entry.reference.standard),
        3 => Some(&entry.reference.subset),
        4 => Some(&entry.owner.parent.artifact_id),
        5 => Some(&entry.owner.parent.artifact_kind),
        6 => Some(&entry.owner.parent.standard),
        7 => Some(&entry.owner.parent.subset),
        8 => Some(&entry.owner.slot),
        9 => Some(&entry.owner.child_id),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn document_archive_member_identity_mut(entry: &mut protocol::OwnedDocumentMemberPackEntry, field: u8) -> Option<&mut String> {
    match field {
        0 => Some(&mut entry.reference.artifact_id),
        1 => Some(&mut entry.reference.artifact_kind),
        2 => Some(&mut entry.reference.standard),
        3 => Some(&mut entry.reference.subset),
        4 => Some(&mut entry.owner.parent.artifact_id),
        5 => Some(&mut entry.owner.parent.artifact_kind),
        6 => Some(&mut entry.owner.parent.standard),
        7 => Some(&mut entry.owner.parent.subset),
        8 => Some(&mut entry.owner.slot),
        9 => Some(&mut entry.owner.child_id),
        _ => None,
    }
}

#[doc(hidden)]
pub struct ActiveDocumentArchiveLoad<P, Mutation>
where
    P: semio_framework_value::ToValue,
    Mutation: Clone + semio_framework_value::ToValue + semio_framework_value::FromValue + store::Mutation<P>,
{
    pub operation: u64,
    pub archive: Option<Box<protocol::DocumentArchivePack>>,
    archive_retirement: Option<Box<dyn store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement>>,
    pub history: Option<protocol::RetainedHistoryDecode>,
    history_custody: Option<(Option<protocol::HistoryLog>, Option<protocol::HistoryLog>, Option<(Vec<String>, Vec<String>)>)>,
    pub decoded_history: Option<protocol::HistoryLog>,
    pub member: Option<PendingDocumentArchiveMember>,
    pub rejected_ingress: Option<OwnedDocumentMemberIngress>,
    pub retained: Option<Box<dyn store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement>>,
    pub retained_pending: Option<(Option<protocol::HistoryLog>, Option<(Vec<String>, Vec<String>)>)>,
    pub hydration: Option<store::RetainedPersistedDocumentHydration<P, Mutation>>,
    pub(crate) hydration_sequence: u64,
    pub replacement: Option<ArtifactEnvelopeDecodeOperationHandle>,
    pub genesis_complete: bool,
    pub phase: ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadPhase,
    pub terminal_target: Option<ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState>,
    close_identity_field: u8,
    pub state: ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState,
    pub completed: u64,
    pub total: u64,
    pub fold: (u64, u64),
    pub decoded: u64,
    pub merge: bool,
    pub ahead: u64,
    pub fault: Vec<u8>,
}

impl<P, Mutation> ActiveDocumentArchiveLoad<P, Mutation>
where
    P: Clone + semio_framework_value::ToValue + semio_framework_value::FromValue + ArtifactPack + ::semio_framework_os_kernel::os_store::serialization::ArtifactStoreSnapshot + Send + Sync + 'static,
    Mutation: Clone + semio_framework_value::ToValue + semio_framework_value::FromValue + store::Mutation<P> + OpBinary + OpText + Send + 'static,
{
    pub fn new(operation: u64, archive: protocol::DocumentArchivePack, history: protocol::RetainedHistoryDecode) -> Self {
        let total = archive.members.len() as u64 + 1;
        Self {
            operation,
            archive: Some(Box::new(archive)),
            archive_retirement: None,
            history: Some(history),
            history_custody: None,
            decoded_history: None,
            member: None,
            rejected_ingress: None,
            retained: None,
            retained_pending: None,
            hydration: None,
            hydration_sequence: 0,
            replacement: None,
            genesis_complete: false,
            phase: ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadPhase::DecodeParent,
            terminal_target: None,
            close_identity_field: 0,
            state: ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Pending,
            completed: 0,
            total,
            fold: (0, 0),
            decoded: 0,
            merge: false,
            ahead: 0,
            fault: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn status(&self) -> protocol::DocumentArchiveLoadStatus {
        let state = match self.state {
            ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Pending => protocol::DocumentArchiveLoadState::Pending,
            ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Running => protocol::DocumentArchiveLoadState::Running,
            ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Ready => protocol::DocumentArchiveLoadState::Ready,
            ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Cancelled => protocol::DocumentArchiveLoadState::Cancelled,
            ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Fault => protocol::DocumentArchiveLoadState::Fault,
        };
        protocol::DocumentArchiveLoadStatus { operation: self.operation, state, completed: self.completed.saturating_add(self.fold.0), total: self.total.saturating_add(self.fold.1), ahead: self.ahead, fault: self.fault.clone() }
    }

    pub fn terminal(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.state, ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Ready | ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Cancelled | ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Fault)
    }

    /// ⏳️ Whether the document is still being loaded: not once the load ended, not while a cancelled, faulted or
    /// committed load only retires what it held — the document is then already the one it will stay — and never for a
    /// read-back merge, which replaces nothing.
    pub fn loading(&self) -> bool {
        !self.merge && !self.terminal() && self.terminal_target.is_none()
    }

    /// 🫙️ Every original input owner is returned; only the encoded fault diagnostic the terminal Fault status carries may remain.
    pub fn inputs_are_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.archive.is_none() && self.archive_retirement.is_none() && self.history.is_none() && self.history_custody.is_none() && self.decoded_history.is_none() && self.member.is_none() && self.rejected_ingress.is_none() && self.retained.is_none() && self.hydration.is_none() && self.replacement.is_none()
    }

    pub fn terminal_is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.inputs_are_empty() && self.fault.capacity() == 0
    }

    pub fn request_terminal(&mut self, target: ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState) {
        if self.terminal_target.is_none() {
            self.terminal_target = Some(target);
        }
    }

    /// 🔀️ Whether a read-back merge decoded its log and waits for the host's poll turn to merge it.
    pub fn awaits_merge(&self) -> bool {
        self.phase == ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadPhase::MergeParent && self.terminal_target.is_none()
    }

    pub fn request_fault(&mut self, fault: &Fault) {
        if self.terminal_target.is_none() {
            self.fault = semio_framework_diagnostic::encode_fault_bytes(fault);
            self.terminal_target = Some(ActiveDocumentArchiveLoadState::Fault);
        }
    }
    /// 📏️ Quotes complete original child currency before history or archive ownership moves.
    pub fn retirement_demands(&self, body: usize) -> Result<RetirementDemand, ValueError> {
        let parent=|mut demand:RetirementDemand|->Result<RetirementDemand,ValueError>{demand.depth=demand.depth.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(||ValueError::literal(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::DepthLimit,"archive retirement parent depth overflow"))?;Ok(demand)};
        if self.replacement.is_some(){return Err(ValueError::literal(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::UnsupportedOwner,"archive replacement awaits its original operation recipient"));}
        if let Some(owner)=self.retained.as_ref(){return parent(store::os_store::snapshot_read::artifact_retirement_box_demands(owner,body)?);}
        if let Some(owner)=self.archive_retirement.as_ref(){return parent(store::os_store::snapshot_read::artifact_retirement_box_demands(owner,body)?);}
        if let Some(hydration)=self.hydration.as_ref(){
            if store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::terminal_is_empty(hydration){return Ok(RetirementDemand{depth:1,..Default::default()});}
            return parent(RetirementDemand{copy_bytes:store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::next_copy_byte_demand(hydration)?,capacity_bytes:store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::next_capacity_byte_demand(hydration,body)?,release_bytes:store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::next_release_byte_demand(hydration)?,depth:store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::next_depth_demand(hydration)?});
        }
        if let Some(ingress)=self.rejected_ingress.as_ref(){return if ingress.terminal_is_empty(){Ok(RetirementDemand{depth:1,..Default::default()})}else{parent(ingress.retirement_demands(body)?)};}
        if let Some(member)=self.member.as_ref(){return if member.terminal_is_empty(){Ok(RetirementDemand{depth:1,..Default::default()})}else{parent(member.retirement_demands(body)?)};}
        if self.history_custody.is_some()||self.history.is_some()||self.decoded_history.is_some(){return Ok(RetirementDemand{capacity_bytes:semio_framework_value::retirement::owned_retirement_birth_bytes::<(Option<protocol::HistoryLog>,Option<protocol::HistoryLog>,Option<(Vec<String>,Vec<String>)>)>(),depth:2,..Default::default()});}
        if self.archive.is_some(){return Ok(RetirementDemand{capacity_bytes:semio_framework_value::retirement::owned_retirement_birth_bytes::<Box<protocol::DocumentArchivePack>>(),depth:2,..Default::default()});}
        Ok(Default::default())
    }

    /// 🎟️ Retains all original history and physical archive backing until full admission succeeds.
    pub fn close_step(&mut self, grant: RetainedCloneGrant) -> Result<RetainedCloneStep, ValueError> {
        let empty=RetainedCloneProgress::default();
        if self.terminal_is_empty(){return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Complete(empty));}
        let demand=self.retirement_demands(grant.maximum_copy_bytes)?;
        if grant.maximum_items==0||grant.maximum_copy_bytes<demand.copy_bytes||grant.maximum_capacity_bytes<demand.capacity_bytes||grant.maximum_release_bytes<demand.release_bytes||grant.maximum_depth<demand.depth{return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(empty));}
        let child=RetainedCloneGrant{maximum_depth:grant.maximum_depth-1,..grant};
        if self.retained.is_some(){return store::os_store::snapshot_read::artifact_retirement_box_close_step(&mut self.retained,child).map(|step|RetainedCloneStep::Progress(step.progress()));}
        if self.archive_retirement.is_some(){return store::os_store::snapshot_read::artifact_retirement_box_close_step(&mut self.archive_retirement,child).map(|step|RetainedCloneStep::Progress(step.progress()));}
        if let Some(hydration)=self.hydration.as_mut(){
            if store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::terminal_is_empty(hydration){drop(self.hydration.take());return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,..empty}));}
            let step=store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::close_step(hydration,child)?;
            semio_framework_value::retained_clone::admit_retained_clone_close(child,step,store::ErasedSnapshotRetirement::terminal_is_empty(hydration),"original archive hydration")?;
            return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(step.progress()));
        }
        if let Some(ingress)=self.rejected_ingress.as_mut(){
            if ingress.terminal_is_empty(){drop(self.rejected_ingress.take());return Ok(RetainedCloneStep::Progress(RetainedCloneProgress{copied_items:1,..empty}));}
            let step=ingress.close_step(child)?;semio_framework_value::retained_clone::admit_retained_clone_close(child,step,ingress.terminal_is_empty(),"original archive ingress")?;

struct CheckpointWriter<'a> {
    output: Vec<u8>,
    sink: Option<&'a mut dyn FnMut(&[u8])->Result<(),semio_framework_value::ValueError>>,
    error: Option<semio_framework_value::ValueError>,
}

impl CheckpointWriter<'_> {
    fn byte(&mut self, value: u8) {
        self.bytes(&[value]);
    }

    fn bytes(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        if self.error.is_some(){return;}
        if let Some(sink)=self.sink.as_mut(){if let Err(error)=sink(bytes){self.error=Some(error);}}else{self.output.extend_from_slice(bytes);}
    }

    fn u32(&mut self, value: u32) {
        self.bytes(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }

    fn u64(&mut self, value: u64) {
        self.bytes(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }

    fn usize(&mut self, value: usize) {
        self.u64(value as u64);
    }

    fn sized_bytes(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        self.usize(bytes.len());
        self.bytes(bytes);
    }

    fn list<T>(&mut self, values: &[T], mut write: impl FnMut(&mut Self, &T)) {
        self.usize(values.len());
        for value in values {
            if self.error.is_some(){break;}
            write(self, value);
        }
    }

    fn option<T>(&mut self, value: Option<T>, write: impl FnOnce(&mut Self, T)) {
        match value {
            Some(value) => {
                self.byte(1);
                write(self, value);
            }
            None => self.byte(0),
        }
    }

    fn value(&mut self, value: Value) {
        match value {
            Value::I32(value) => {
                self.byte(0);
                self.u32(value as u32);
            }
            Value::I64(value) => {
                self.byte(1);
                self.u64(value as u64);
            }
            Value::F32(value) => {
                self.byte(2);
                self.u32(value);
            }
            Value::F64(value) => {
                self.byte(3);
                self.u64(value);
            }
            Value::FuncRef(value) => {
                self.byte(4);
                self.option(value, Self::u32);
            }
            Value::ExternRef(value) => {
                self.byte(5);
                self.option(value, Self::u64);
            }
        }
    }

    fn value_type(&mut self, value: ValueType) {
        self.byte(match value {
            ValueType::I32 => 0,
            ValueType::I64 => 1,
            ValueType::F32 => 2,
            ValueType::F64 => 3,
            ValueType::FuncRef => 4,
            ValueType::ExternRef => 5,
        });
    }

    fn string(&mut self, value: &str) {
        self.sized_bytes(value.as_bytes());
    }

    fn machine(&mut self, machine: &Machine) {
        self.list(&machine.values, |writer, value| writer.value(*value));
        self.list(&machine.frames, Self::frame);
        self.option(machine.pending_host.as_ref(), Self::pending_host);
    }

    fn frame(&mut self, frame: &Frame) {
        self.u32(frame.function);
        self.usize(frame.pc);
        self.usize(frame.stack_base);
        self.list(&frame.locals, |writer, value| writer.value(*value));
        self.list(&frame.controls, Self::control);
    }

    fn control(&mut self, control: &ControlFrame) {

            ControlKind::Function => 0,
            ControlKind::Block => 1,
            ControlKind::Loop => 2,
            ControlKind::If => 3,
        });

        self.usize(control.end_pc);
        self.usize(control.stack_height);
        self.list(&control.branch_types, |writer, value| writer.value_type(*value));
        self.list(&control.result_types, |writer, value| writer.value_type(*value));
    }

    fn pending_host(&mut self, pending: &PendingHost) {
        self.u64(pending.call.id);
        self.string(&pending.call.module);
        self.string(&pending.call.name);
        self.list(&pending.call.arguments, |writer, value| writer.value(*value));
        self.list(&pending.call.results, |writer, value| writer.value_type(*value));

    }
}

struct CheckpointReader<'a>(Decoder<'a>);

impl<'a> CheckpointReader<'a> {
    fn new(bytes: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        Self(Decoder::new(bytes))
    }

    fn done(&self) -> bool {
        self.0.done()
    }

    fn byte(&mut self) -> Result<u8, CoreError> {
        self.0.byte().map_err(|error| CoreError::State(error.to_string()))
    }

    fn bytes(&mut self, length: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8], CoreError> {
        self.0.bytes(length).map_err(|error| CoreError::State(error.to_string()))
    }

    fn u32(&mut self) -> Result<u32, CoreError> {
        Ok(u32::from_le_bytes(self.bytes(4)?.try_into().expect("four bytes")))
    }

    fn u64(&mut self) -> Result<u64, CoreError> {
        Ok(u64::from_le_bytes(self.bytes(8)?.try_into().expect("eight bytes")))
    }

    fn usize(&mut self) -> Result<usize, CoreError> {
        usize::try_from(self.u64()?).map_err(|_| CoreError::State("checkpoint length exceeds host usize".into()))
    }

    fn sized_bytes(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CoreError> {
        let length = self.usize()?;
        Ok(self.bytes(length)?.to_vec())
    }

    fn list<T>(&mut self, mut read: impl FnMut(&mut Self) -> Result<T, CoreError>) -> Result<Vec<T>, CoreError> {
        let count = self.usize()?;
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        values.try_reserve(count).map_err(|_| CoreError::State("checkpoint vector allocation failed".into()))?;
        for _ in 0..count {
            values.push(read(self)?);
        }
        Ok(values)
    }

    fn option<T>(&mut self, read: impl FnOnce(&mut Self) -> Result<T, CoreError>) -> Result<Option<T>, CoreError> {
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => Ok(None),
            1 => read(self).map(Some),
            other => Err(CoreError::State(format!("checkpoint option tag {other} is invalid"))),
        }
    }

    fn value(&mut self) -> Result<Value, CoreError> {
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => Ok(Value::I32(self.u32()? as i32)),
            1 => Ok(Value::I64(self.u64()? as i64)),
            2 => Ok(Value::F32(self.u32()?)),
            3 => Ok(Value::F64(self.u64()?)),
            4 => Ok(Value::FuncRef(self.option(Self::u32)?)),
            5 => Ok(Value::ExternRef(self.option(Self::u64)?)),
            tag => Err(CoreError::State(format!("checkpoint value tag {tag} is invalid"))),
        }
    }

    fn value_type(&mut self) -> Result<ValueType, CoreError> {
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => Ok(ValueType::I32),
            1 => Ok(ValueType::I64),
            2 => Ok(ValueType::F32),
            3 => Ok(ValueType::F64),
            4 => Ok(ValueType::FuncRef),
            5 => Ok(ValueType::ExternRef),
            tag => Err(CoreError::State(format!("checkpoint value-type tag {tag} is invalid"))),
        }
    }

    fn string(&mut self) -> Result<String, CoreError> {
        String::from_utf8(self.sized_bytes()?).map_err(|_| CoreError::State("checkpoint string is not UTF-8".into()))
    }

    fn machine(&mut self) -> Result<Machine, CoreError> {
        Ok(Machine { values: self.list(Self::value)?, frames: self.list(Self::frame)?, pending_host: self.option(Self::pending_host)? })
    }

    fn frame(&mut self) -> Result<Frame, CoreError> {
        Ok(Frame { function: self.u32()?, pc: self.usize()?, stack_base: self.usize()?, locals: self.list(Self::value)?, controls: self.list(Self::control)? })
    }

    fn control(&mut self) -> Result<ControlFrame, CoreError> {
        let kind = match self.byte()? {
            0 => ControlKind::Function,
            1 => ControlKind::Block,
            2 => ControlKind::Loop,
            3 => ControlKind::If,

        let results = self.list(Self::value_type)?;
        let stack_height = self.usize()?;
        Ok(PendingHost { call: HostCall { id, module, name, arguments, results }, stack_height })
    }
}

fn validate_machine(module: &CoreModule, machine: Option<&Machine>) -> Result<(), CoreError> {
    let Some(machine) = machine else { return Ok(()) };
    if machine.frames.is_empty() {
        return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint machine has no frames".into()));
    }
    for frame in &machine.frames {
        let declaration = module.functions.get(frame.function as usize).ok_or_else(|| CoreError::State("checkpoint frame function is out of bounds".into()))?;
        let (body, function_type, local_types) = match declaration {
            FunctionDecl::Defined { locals, body, .. } => (body, module.function_type(frame.function)?, locals),
            FunctionDecl::Import { .. } => return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint frame points at an import".into())),
        };
        if frame.pc > body.len() || frame.stack_base > machine.values.len() || frame.locals.len() != function_type.parameters.len() + local_types.len() {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint frame shape is invalid".into()));
        }
        for (value, value_type) in frame.locals.iter().zip(function_type.parameters.iter().chain(local_types)) {
            expect_type(*value, *value_type)?;
        }
        if frame.controls.is_empty() || frame.controls.iter().any(|control| control.end_pc >= body.len() || control.stack_height > machine.values.len()) {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint control frame shape is invalid".into()));
        }
    }
    if machine.pending_host.as_ref().is_some_and(|pending| pending.stack_height > machine.values.len()) {
        return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint pending host stack height is invalid".into()));
    }
    Ok(())
}

impl CoreInstance {
    /// 👓️ Visits original borrowed checkpoint fields without creating intermediate storage.
    pub(crate) fn visit_checkpoint(&self,visitor:&mut dyn FnMut(&[u8])->Result<(),semio_framework_value::ValueError>)->Result<(),semio_framework_value::ValueError>{
        let mut writer=CheckpointWriter{sink:Some(visitor),..Default::default()};self.write_checkpoint(&mut writer);writer.error.map_or(Ok(()),Err)
    }

    pub fn checkpoint(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut writer = CheckpointWriter::default();
        self.write_checkpoint(&mut writer);
        writer.output
    }

    fn write_checkpoint(&self,writer:&mut CheckpointWriter<'_>){
        writer.bytes(CHECKPOINT_MAGIC);
        writer.byte(CHECKPOINT_VERSION);
        writer.u64(self.module.bytes_fingerprint);
        writer.u64(self.next_host_call);
        writer.list(&self.memories, |writer, memory| writer.sized_bytes(&memory.bytes));
        writer.list(&self.tables, |writer, table| writer.list(&table.values, |writer, value| writer.option(*value, CheckpointWriter::u64)));
        writer.list(&self.globals, |writer, global| writer.value(global.value));
        writer.list(&self.data, |writer, data| writer.option(data.as_ref(), |writer, bytes| writer.sized_bytes(bytes)));
        writer.list(&self.elements, |writer, elements| writer.option(elements.as_ref(), |writer, values| writer.list(values, |writer, value| writer.option(*value, |writer, value| writer.u32(value)))));
        writer.option(self.machine.as_ref(), |writer, machine| writer.machine(machine));
    }

    /// 📤️ Measures borrowed state before original allocation and returns every failure owner to its caller slot.
    pub fn checkpoint_controlled(&self,control:&mut semio_framework_value::NativeEncodeControl<'_>)->Result<Vec<u8>,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{
        use semio_framework_value::{ValueError,ValueRefusalKind};
        control.scoped_stage(|control|{
            control.begin_stage(0)?;let mut count=0usize;
            {let mut sink=|bytes:&[u8]|{count=count.checked_add(bytes.len()).filter(|count|*count<=isize::MAX as usize).ok_or_else(||ValueError::literal(ValueRefusalKind::OwnershipLimit,"owned checkpoint extent exceeds address space"))?;control.advance(bytes.len())};let mut writer=CheckpointWriter{sink:Some(&mut sink),..Default::default()};self.write_checkpoint(&mut writer);if let Some(error)=writer.error{return Err(error);}}
            control.begin_stage(count)?;
            control.with_retirement_owner(size_of::<CheckpointOutputRetirement>(),|control|{
                let mut owner=Box::new(CheckpointOutputRetirement{bytes:std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(None)});
                let result=(||{owner.bytes.replace(control.allocate_vec(count)?);let output=owner.bytes.as_mut().unwrap();let mut sink=|bytes:&[u8]|{let next=output.len().checked_add(bytes.len()).filter(|next|*next<=count).ok_or_else(||ValueError::literal(ValueRefusalKind::InvariantViolated,"checkpoint changed after measured reservation"))?;control.advance(bytes.len())?;output.extend_from_slice(bytes);debug_assert_eq!(output.len(),next);Ok(())};let mut writer=CheckpointWriter{sink:Some(&mut sink),..Default::default()};self.write_checkpoint(&mut writer);if let Some(error)=writer.error{return Err(error);}if owner.bytes.as_ref().unwrap().len()!=count{return Err(ValueError::literal(ValueRefusalKind::InvariantViolated,"checkpoint changed after measured reservation"));}Ok(owner.bytes.take().unwrap())})();
                (result,Some(owner as Box<dyn semio_framework_value::ErasedSnapshotRetirement>))
            })
        })
    }

    pub fn restore(module: Arc<CoreModule>, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, CoreError> {
        let mut reader = CheckpointReader::new(bytes);
        if reader.bytes(CHECKPOINT_MAGIC.len())? != CHECKPOINT_MAGIC || reader.byte()? != CHECKPOINT_VERSION {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint header/version mismatch".into()));
        }
        if reader.u64()? != module.bytes_fingerprint {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint belongs to a different module".into()));
        }
        let next_host_call = reader.u64()?;
        let memory_bytes = reader.list(|reader| reader.sized_bytes())?;
        let table_values = reader.list(|reader| reader.list(|reader| reader.option(CheckpointReader::u64)))?;
        let global_values = reader.list(CheckpointReader::value)?;
        let data = reader.list(|reader| reader.option(CheckpointReader::sized_bytes))?;
        let elements = reader.list(|reader| reader.option(|reader| reader.list(|reader| reader.option(CheckpointReader::u32))))?;
        let machine = reader.option(CheckpointReader::machine)?;
        if !reader.done() {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint has trailing bytes".into()));
        }
        if memory_bytes.len() != module.memories.len() || table_values.len() != module.tables.len() || global_values.len() != module.globals.len() || data.len() != module.data.len() || elements.len() != module.elements.len() {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint state vector count differs from module".into()));
        }
        let memories = memory_bytes
            .into_iter()
            .zip(&module.memories)
            .map(|(bytes, limits)| {
                if bytes.len() % WASM_PAGE_BYTES != 0 || limits.maximum_pages.is_some_and(|maximum| bytes.len() / WASM_PAGE_BYTES > maximum as usize) {
                    return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint memory violates module limits".into()));
                }
                Ok(MemoryState { bytes, maximum_pages: limits.maximum_pages, memory64: limits.memory64 })
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, CoreError>>()?;
        let tables = table_values
            .into_iter()
            .zip(&module.tables)
            .map(|(values, limits)| {
                if limits.maximum.is_some_and(|maximum| values.len() > maximum as usize) {
                    return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint table violates module limits".into()));
                }
                Ok(TableState { values, element: limits.element, maximum: limits.maximum })
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, CoreError>>()?;
        let mut globals = Vec::with_capacity(global_values.len());
        for (value, declaration) in global_values.into_iter().zip(&module.globals) {
            expect_type(value, declaration.value_type)?;
            globals.push(GlobalState { value, mutable: declaration.mutable });
        }
        validate_machine(&module, machine.as_ref())?;
        Ok(Self { module, memories, tables, globals, data, elements, machine, next_host_call })
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct CheckpointWriter<'a> {
    output: Vec<u8>,
    sink: Option<&'a mut dyn FnMut(&[u8])->Result<(),semio_framework_value::ValueError>>,
    error: Option<semio_framework_value::ValueError>,
}

impl CheckpointWriter<'_> {
    fn byte(&mut self, value: u8) {
        self.bytes(&[value]);
    }

    fn bytes(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        if self.error.is_some(){return;}
        if let Some(sink)=self.sink.as_mut(){if let Err(error)=sink(bytes){self.error=Some(error);}}else{self.output.extend_from_slice(bytes);}
    }

    fn u32(&mut self, value: u32) {
        self.bytes(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }

    fn u64(&mut self, value: u64) {
        self.bytes(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }

    fn usize(&mut self, value: usize) {
        self.u64(value as u64);
    }

    fn sized_bytes(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        self.usize(bytes.len());
        self.bytes(bytes);
    }

    fn list<T>(&mut self, values: &[T], mut write: impl FnMut(&mut Self, &T)) {
        self.usize(values.len());
        for value in values {
            if self.error.is_some(){break;}
            write(self, value);
        }
    }

    fn option<T>(&mut self, value: Option<T>, write: impl FnOnce(&mut Self, T)) {
        match value {
            Some(value) => {
                self.byte(1);
                write(self, value);
            }
            None => self.byte(0),
        }
    }

    fn value(&mut self, value: Value) {
        match value {
            Value::I32(value) => {
                self.byte(0);
                self.u32(value as u32);
            }
            Value::I64(value) => {
                self.byte(1);
                self.u64(value as u64);
            }
            Value::F32(value) => {
                self.byte(2);
                self.u32(value);
            }
            Value::F64(value) => {
                self.byte(3);
                self.u64(value);
            }
            Value::FuncRef(value) => {
                self.byte(4);
                self.option(value, Self::u32);
            }
            Value::ExternRef(value) => {
                self.byte(5);
                self.option(value, Self::u64);
            }
        }
    }

    fn value_type(&mut self, value: ValueType) {
        self.byte(match value {
            ValueType::I32 => 0,
            ValueType::I64 => 1,
            ValueType::F32 => 2,
            ValueType::F64 => 3,
            ValueType::FuncRef => 4,
            ValueType::ExternRef => 5,
        });
    }

    fn string(&mut self, value: &str) {
        self.sized_bytes(value.as_bytes());
    }

    fn machine(&mut self, machine: &Machine) {
        self.list(&machine.values, |writer, value| writer.value(*value));
        self.list(&machine.frames, Self::frame);
        self.option(machine.pending_host.as_ref(), Self::pending_host);
    }

    fn frame(&mut self, frame: &Frame) {
        self.u32(frame.function);
        self.usize(frame.pc);
        self.usize(frame.stack_base);
        self.list(&frame.locals, |writer, value| writer.value(*value));
        self.list(&frame.controls, Self::control);
    }

    fn control(&mut self, control: &ControlFrame) {
        self.byte(match control.kind {
            ControlKind::Function => 0,
            ControlKind::Block => 1,
            ControlKind::Loop => 2,
            ControlKind::If => 3,
        });
        self.usize(control.start_pc);
        self.usize(control.end_pc);
        self.usize(control.stack_height);
        self.list(&control.branch_types, |writer, value| writer.value_type(*value));
        self.list(&control.result_types, |writer, value| writer.value_type(*value));
    }

    fn pending_host(&mut self, pending: &PendingHost) {
        self.u64(pending.call.id);
        self.string(&pending.call.module);
        self.string(&pending.call.name);
        self.list(&pending.call.arguments, |writer, value| writer.value(*value));
        self.list(&pending.call.results, |writer, value| writer.value_type(*value));
        self.usize(pending.stack_height);
    }
}

struct CheckpointReader<'a>(Decoder<'a>);

impl<'a> CheckpointReader<'a> {
    fn new(bytes: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        Self(Decoder::new(bytes))
    }

    fn done(&self) -> bool {
        self.0.done()
    }

    fn byte(&mut self) -> Result<u8, CoreError> {
        self.0.byte().map_err(|error| CoreError::State(error.to_string()))
    }

    fn bytes(&mut self, length: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8], CoreError> {
        self.0.bytes(length).map_err(|error| CoreError::State(error.to_string()))
    }

    fn u32(&mut self) -> Result<u32, CoreError> {
        Ok(u32::from_le_bytes(self.bytes(4)?.try_into().expect("four bytes")))
    }

    fn u64(&mut self) -> Result<u64, CoreError> {
        Ok(u64::from_le_bytes(self.bytes(8)?.try_into().expect("eight bytes")))
    }

    fn usize(&mut self) -> Result<usize, CoreError> {
        usize::try_from(self.u64()?).map_err(|_| CoreError::State("checkpoint length exceeds host usize".into()))
    }

    fn sized_bytes(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CoreError> {
        let length = self.usize()?;
        Ok(self.bytes(length)?.to_vec())
    }

    fn list<T>(&mut self, mut read: impl FnMut(&mut Self) -> Result<T, CoreError>) -> Result<Vec<T>, CoreError> {
        let count = self.usize()?;
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        values.try_reserve(count).map_err(|_| CoreError::State("checkpoint vector allocation failed".into()))?;
        for _ in 0..count {
            values.push(read(self)?);
        }
        Ok(values)
    }

    fn option<T>(&mut self, read: impl FnOnce(&mut Self) -> Result<T, CoreError>) -> Result<Option<T>, CoreError> {
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => Ok(None),
            1 => read(self).map(Some),
            other => Err(CoreError::State(format!("checkpoint option tag {other} is invalid"))),
        }
    }

    fn value(&mut self) -> Result<Value, CoreError> {
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => Ok(Value::I32(self.u32()? as i32)),
            1 => Ok(Value::I64(self.u64()? as i64)),
            2 => Ok(Value::F32(self.u32()?)),
            3 => Ok(Value::F64(self.u64()?)),
            4 => Ok(Value::FuncRef(self.option(Self::u32)?)),
            5 => Ok(Value::ExternRef(self.option(Self::u64)?)),
            tag => Err(CoreError::State(format!("checkpoint value tag {tag} is invalid"))),
        }
    }

    fn value_type(&mut self) -> Result<ValueType, CoreError> {
        match self.byte()? {
            0 => Ok(ValueType::I32),
            1 => Ok(ValueType::I64),
            2 => Ok(ValueType::F32),
            3 => Ok(ValueType::F64),
            4 => Ok(ValueType::FuncRef),
            5 => Ok(ValueType::ExternRef),
            tag => Err(CoreError::State(format!("checkpoint value-type tag {tag} is invalid"))),
        }
    }

    fn string(&mut self) -> Result<String, CoreError> {
        String::from_utf8(self.sized_bytes()?).map_err(|_| CoreError::State("checkpoint string is not UTF-8".into()))
    }

    fn machine(&mut self) -> Result<Machine, CoreError> {
        Ok(Machine { values: self.list(Self::value)?, frames: self.list(Self::frame)?, pending_host: self.option(Self::pending_host)? })
    }

    fn frame(&mut self) -> Result<Frame, CoreError> {
        Ok(Frame { function: self.u32()?, pc: self.usize()?, stack_base: self.usize()?, locals: self.list(Self::value)?, controls: self.list(Self::control)? })
    }

    fn control(&mut self) -> Result<ControlFrame, CoreError> {
        let kind = match self.byte()? {
            0 => ControlKind::Function,
            1 => ControlKind::Block,
            2 => ControlKind::Loop,
            3 => ControlKind::If,
            tag => return Err(CoreError::State(format!("checkpoint control tag {tag} is invalid"))),
        };
        Ok(ControlFrame { kind, start_pc: self.usize()?, end_pc: self.usize()?, stack_height: self.usize()?, branch_types: self.list(Self::value_type)?, result_types: self.list(Self::value_type)? })
    }

    fn pending_host(&mut self) -> Result<PendingHost, CoreError> {
        let id = self.u64()?;
        let module = self.string()?;
        let name = self.string()?;
        let arguments = self.list(Self::value)?;
        let results = self.list(Self::value_type)?;
        let stack_height = self.usize()?;
        Ok(PendingHost { call: HostCall { id, module, name, arguments, results }, stack_height })
    }
}

fn validate_machine(module: &CoreModule, machine: Option<&Machine>) -> Result<(), CoreError> {
    let Some(machine) = machine else { return Ok(()) };
    if machine.frames.is_empty() {
        return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint machine has no frames".into()));
    }
    for frame in &machine.frames {
        let declaration = module.functions.get(frame.function as usize).ok_or_else(|| CoreError::State("checkpoint frame function is out of bounds".into()))?;
        let (body, function_type, local_types) = match declaration {
            FunctionDecl::Defined { locals, body, .. } => (body, module.function_type(frame.function)?, locals),
            FunctionDecl::Import { .. } => return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint frame points at an import".into())),
        };
        if frame.pc > body.len() || frame.stack_base > machine.values.len() || frame.locals.len() != function_type.parameters.len() + local_types.len() {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint frame shape is invalid".into()));
        }
        for (value, value_type) in frame.locals.iter().zip(function_type.parameters.iter().chain(local_types)) {
            expect_type(*value, *value_type)?;
        }
        if frame.controls.is_empty() || frame.controls.iter().any(|control| control.end_pc >= body.len() || control.stack_height > machine.values.len()) {
            return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint control frame shape is invalid".into()));
        }
    }
    if machine.pending_host.as_ref().is_some_and(|pending| pending.stack_height > machine.values.len()) {
        return Err(CoreError::State("checkpoint pending host stack height is invalid".into()));
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub mod artifact_app_laws {
    //! 🧪️ Generic test-harness helpers for `ArtifactApp` implementors. Factors out the ~24x duplicated
    //! `meta()`/`new_app()`/`new_app_with_registry()`/`paired_apps()` boilerplate plus the repeated
    //! undo-redo / two-instance-convergence / ingest-idempotency test *bodies* (parameterized by closures
    //! for the app-specific action names/snapshot shape, so only the control flow is shared). Not
    //! Enabled only by this crate's tests or the explicit `artifact-app-testing` feature; see
    //! `terminology_tests`/`panel_kit_tests` above for the sibling pattern of testing SDK primitives
    //! themselves inline.

    pub use super::OriginalFixtureCaller;
    use super::{register_framework_reserved_factories, ActionMeta, App, AppActionRegistry, ArtifactApp, ArtifactToolFactoryRegistry, PluginApp, TypedOperationResultLane, VcsArtifactApp};
    use semio_framework_value::retained_clone::{RetainedCloneGrant, RetainedCloneProgress};
    use store::{os_store::backbone::Backbone, os_store::backbone::BackboneMessage, os_store::backbone::MemoryBackbone};

    /// 🎟️ Drives the actual borrowed action endpoint and pays remaining original fixture sources under its authored close loan.
    pub async fn dispatch_fixture_action<P:PluginApp>(app:&mut P,action:&str,args:Option<super::DslValue>,meta:&ActionMeta,identity:&mut semio_framework_os_kernel::os_vcs::io::binary::entity_identity::control::EntityIdentityAuthority<'_>,cx:&mut semio_framework_job::StepContext<'_>,close_loan:RetainedCloneGrant)->Result<super::InvocationResult,semio_framework_job::OriginalTurnFailure>{
        let mut original_args=args;
        let mut result=Ok(None);
        for _ in 0..OriginalFixtureCaller::maximum_turns(){
            result=app.handle_action(action,&mut original_args,meta,identity,cx).await;
            if !matches!(result,Ok(None)){break}
            if let Err(failure)=app.maintenance_step(cx,close_loan){result=Err(failure.into());break}
        }
        close_fixture_action_inputs(original_args,None,cx,close_loan);
        result?.ok_or_else(||semio_framework_value::ValueError::literal(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::WorkLimit,"original action fixture dispatch exceeded its authored turn bound").into())
    }

    /// 📨️ Exercises the real continuation receiver with one original argument and fault pair.
    pub async fn dispatch_fixture_response_action<P:PluginApp>(app:&mut P,action:&str,args:Option<super::DslValue>,fault:Option<super::Fault>,meta:&ActionMeta,identity:&mut semio_framework_os_kernel::os_vcs::io::binary::entity_identity::control::EntityIdentityAuthority<'_>,cx:&mut semio_framework_job::StepContext<'_>,close_loan:RetainedCloneGrant)->Result<super::InvocationResult,semio_framework_job::OriginalTurnFailure>{
        let(mut original_args,mut original_fault)=(args,fault);let mut result=Ok(None);
        for _ in 0..OriginalFixtureCaller::maximum_turns(){result=app.handle_response_action(action,&mut original_args,&mut original_fault,meta,identity,cx).await;if !matches!(result,Ok(None)){break}if let Err(failure)=app.maintenance_step(cx,close_loan){result=Err(failure.into());break}}
        close_fixture_action_inputs(original_args,original_fault,cx,close_loan);
        result?.ok_or_else(||semio_framework_value::ValueError::literal(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::WorkLimit,"original continuation fixture dispatch exceeded its authored turn bound").into())
    }

    fn close_fixture_action_inputs(args:Option<super::DslValue>,fault:Option<super::Fault>,cx:&mut semio_framework_job::StepContext<'_>,close_loan:RetainedCloneGrant){
        if args.is_some()||fault.is_some(){
            let mut receiving=Some(crate::action_ingress::ActionIngressSource{action:None,args,prepared:None,assembled:None,fault});
            let mut original_caller=None;
            let mut owner=crate::action_ingress::ActionIngressRecord::receive(&mut receiving,&mut original_caller,cx).expect("original fixture action receiving receipt").expect("authored caller must fund original unused argument receiving");
            owner.finish_parser();
            for _ in 0..OriginalFixtureCaller::maximum_turns(){
                if owner.terminal_is_empty(){break}
                cx.with_retained_loan(close_loan,|same|owner.close_original_step(same)).expect("original fixture action unused argument close");
            }
            assert!(owner.terminal_is_empty(),"original fixture action unused source did not complete its paid close");
        }
    }

    /// 🔬️ Borrows one real app registry publication for a synchronous integration-law closure.
    pub async fn with_document_view<A, M, R>(app: &mut VcsArtifactApp<A, M>, inspect: impl for<'a> FnOnce(&super::ArtifactView<'a, A::Snapshot>) -> R) -> Result<R, super::Fault>
    where
        A: ArtifactApp,
        M: super::SpaceMember + super::MemberFactory + Send + 'static,
    {
        app.render_ctx().refresh_cache().await?;
        let read = app.stores.store.snapshot_read().map_err(semio_framework_diagnostic::FaultFrom::into_fault)?;
        let (generation, revision) = (app.stores.store.generation_now(), app.stores.store.content_revision());
        if !read.commit_authority_matches(generation, revision) {
            return Err(super::Fault::new(super::FaultOrigin::Framework, super::FaultCode::new("framework.artifact-law.publication-invariant"), "law parent snapshot publication changed before document view capture").with_param("refusalKind", semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvariantViolated.as_str()));
        }
        let (_, snapshot, _, history) = app.history.cache.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| super::plugin_sdk_fault("law document view cache was not prepared"))?;
        if !std::ptr::eq(snapshot.as_ref(), read.get()) {
            return Err(super::Fault::new(super::FaultOrigin::Framework, super::FaultCode::new("framework.artifact-law.publication-invariant"), "law history cache belongs to a different parent snapshot publication").with_param("refusalKind", semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvariantViolated.as_str()));
        }
        let view = super::ArtifactView::with_children(read.get(), history.as_ref(), super::ChildContentView::clone(&app.child_composition.child_content_root));
        Ok(inspect(&view))
    }

    /// 🎟️ The explicit mounted owner policy every testkit fixture instance runs under.
    pub fn fixture_mounted_policy() -> crate::MountedOwnerPolicyV1 {
        let grant = RetainedCloneGrant { maximum_items: 1, maximum_copy_bytes: 32_768, maximum_capacity_bytes: 262_144, maximum_release_bytes: 1_048_576, maximum_depth: 4_096 };
        crate::MountedOwnerPolicyV1 { preparation: grant, maintenance: grant, close: grant }
    }

    /// 🎟️ One valid original retained turn input for a fixture `Budget`.
    pub fn fixture_retained_turn() -> semio_framework::kernel::RetainedTurnInput {
        semio_framework::kernel::RetainedTurnInput { operation: 1, generation: 1, epoch: 1, grant: fixture_mounted_policy().maintenance }
    }

    /// 🧮️ One fresh unfunded-by-default step context carrying exactly the operation, generation and grant of [`fixture_retained_turn`] (a kernel turn refuses a context its retained input does not name); its sequence and progress cells are leaked, which costs a few bytes per call.
    pub fn fixture_step_context() -> semio_framework_job::StepContext<'static> {
        fixture_step_context_for(fixture_retained_turn())
    }

    /// 🧮️ [`fixture_step_context`] for any retained turn input: the context names exactly that input's operation, generation and grant, so a fixture that funds a turn with a narrower grant (or none) hands the kernel a context that agrees.
    pub fn fixture_step_context_for(turn: semio_framework::kernel::RetainedTurnInput) -> semio_framework_job::StepContext<'static> {
        let sequence: &'static mut u64 = Box::leak(Box::new(0));
        let progress: &'static mut semio_framework_value::RetainedCloneProgress = Box::leak(Box::default());
        semio_framework_job::StepContext::new(semio_framework_job::OperationId(turn.operation), semio_framework_job::Generation(turn.generation), semio_framework_job::StepBudget::new(1_000_000, u64::MAX, turn.grant), semio_framework_job::root_cancel_token(), || Some(0), sequence, progress)
    }

    /// 📒️ One leaked retained-progress cell for a hand-built `StepContext`.
    pub fn fixture_progress() -> &'static mut semio_framework_value::RetainedCloneProgress {
        Box::leak(Box::default())
    }

    /// 🤝️ Resolves a payload-free fixture job outcome (yield, cancelled or empty completion) from its descriptor.
    pub fn fixture_job_outcome<'a>(descriptor: &'a semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeDescriptor) -> Result<semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeView<'a>, semio_framework_value::ValueError> {
        match descriptor.kind() {
            semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeKind::Yield => descriptor.yielded(),
            semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeKind::Cancelled => descriptor.cancelled(),
            semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeKind::Complete => descriptor.complete(None, None),
            _ => Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::literal(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvariantViolated, "fixture job lends no payload outcome")),
        }
    }

    /// 📬️ Everything a fixture test reads from one lent job outcome; payload bytes are copied out, the payload itself stays in the job's custody.
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum FixtureStepOutcome {
        Idle,
        Yield,
        Preview(Vec<u8>),
        Checkpoint { applied_progress: u64, state: Vec<u8> },
        Complete { state: Vec<u8>, output: Vec<u8> },
        Cancelled,
        Fault(Vec<u8>),
    }

    /// 📖️ Concatenates every page of one retained payload.
    pub fn fixture_payload_bytes(payload: &semio_framework_job::RetainedJobPayload) -> Vec<u8> {
        (0..payload.page_count()).filter_map(|index| payload.page(index)).flatten().copied().collect()
    }

    /// ▶️ Drives one job turn and summarises the lent outcome so the borrow ends before the test touches the job again.
    pub fn fixture_step<J: semio_framework_job::InteractiveJob + ?Sized>(job: &mut J, cx: &mut semio_framework_job::StepContext<'_>) -> FixtureStepOutcome {
        use semio_framework_job::JobOutcomeBorrow as B;
        match job.step(cx).expect("fixture job step") {
            None => FixtureStepOutcome::Idle,
            Some(B::Yield { .. }) => FixtureStepOutcome::Yield,
            Some(B::PreviewReady { payload, .. }) => FixtureStepOutcome::Preview(fixture_payload_bytes(payload)),
            Some(B::CheckpointReady { state, applied_progress, .. }) => FixtureStepOutcome::Checkpoint { applied_progress, state: fixture_payload_bytes(state) },
            Some(B::Complete { state, output, .. }) => FixtureStepOutcome::Complete { state: state.map(fixture_payload_bytes).unwrap_or_default(), output: output.map(fixture_payload_bytes).unwrap_or_default() },
            Some(B::Cancelled { .. }) => FixtureStepOutcome::Cancelled,
